card.name: Allergy and sensitivity history wording
card.fires_on: Words naming allergy or sensitivity (sensitivities, sensitivity, sensitive, allergy) or the word 'to' after 'hypersensitivity reactions', right before the named allergen or drug.

modes.label: Sensitivity words
modes.description: Forms of sensitive or allergy that come just before 'to' plus an allergen.
modes.example: A careful inquiry should be made concerning previous sensit<<ivities>> to drugs and other allergens.

modes.label: 'To' after hypersensitivity reactions
modes.description: The word TO in capitalized warnings about previous reactions, before a drug name.
modes.example: CAREFUL INQUIRY SHOULD BE MADE TO DETERMINE WHETHER THE PATIENT HAS HAD PREVIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS<< TO>> CEFOTETAN, CEP

modes.label: Allergic conditions in patient history
modes.description: Allergy-related conditions such as asthma named in patient history or test settings.
modes.example: Monitor closely when used in patients with a history of<< allergy>> or bronchial asthma.
